metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Fury of Waves, Song of Steel! 

Crush your opponents with iron or sink them in the depths—either way you wield the chilling might of the Iron Tide theme deck! 



Contents:

• 1 60-card preconstructed deck

• Damage counters

• 1 coin

metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Strength of Spirit, Strength of Stone! 

This deck’s got heart—the kind of prizefighter’s heart that never quits! With the Stone Heart theme deck, your Pokemon can poison, paralyze, and trick opposing Pokemon in many ways—and the mighty Regirock leads the way, with its Unyielding Rock attack perfect for taking down Pokémon EX! 



Contents:

• 1 60-card preconstructed deck

• Damage counters

• 1 coin

metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[G] Sleep Poison (10)

Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokemon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

metadata.name: Attack 2
metadata.label: Attack 2
metadata.value:
[1G] Unseen Claw (60+)

If your opponent's Active Pokemon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 70 more damage.

metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value: Ancient Trait - Theta Stop  Prevent all affects of your opponent's Pokemon Abilities done to this Pokemon.

metadata.name: Attack 1
metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[1G] Jagged Saber (100)

You may attach up to 2 Grass Energy from your hand to your Benched Pokemon in any way you like. If you attached Energy to a Pokemon in this way, heal all damage from that Pokemon.

metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Ability - Scoundrel Ring 

When you play this Pokemon from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your deck for up to 3 Pokemon EX (except for Hoopa EX), reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

metadata.name: Attack 1
metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[PPP] Hyperspace Fury

Discard 2 Energy attached to this Pokemon. This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

metadata.name: Attack 2
metadata.label: Attack 2
metadata.value:
[2DD] Break Ground (130)

This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value: Ancient Trait - Theta Double  This Pokemon may have up to 2 Pokemon Tool cards attached to it.

metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[2DD] Destroyer King (110+)

This attack does 60 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokemon.

metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[1WW] Glaciate

This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

metadata.name: Attack 2
metadata.label: Attack 2
metadata.value:
[1WWW] Icecalibur (130)

Discard an Energy attached to this Pokemon. The Defending Pokemon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

metadata.name: Attack 1
metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[1] Thunder Rod

Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and attach as many Lightning Energy cards you find there as you like to this Pokemon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

metadata.name: Attack 2
metadata.label: Attack 2
metadata.value:
[2LL] Sparkling Tail (100)

This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokemon.

metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[2LL] Exa Volt (120+)

You may do 50 more damage. If you do, your opponent's Active Pokemon is now Paralyzed and this Pokemon does 30 damage to itself.

metadata.name: Attack 1
metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[1F] Steaming Mad (20x)

This attack does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on this Pokemon. This Pokemon is now Confused.

metadata.label: Attack 2
metadata.value:
[1FF] Crazy Hammer (80+)

If this Pokemon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, remove all Special Conditions from this Pokemon.

metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Ability - Renegade Pulse

If your opponent's Active Pokemon is Mega Evolved, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokemon.

This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokemon.
